arrival_intro.line: Sensors read a cold beachhead ahead. Whatever landed here is already moving.
The tide brought us in. The tide will bury you.
Then we hold this line, and we hold it together.

midpoint_rally.line: Halfway up the ridge and they still keep coming. This is a staging ground, not a patrol.
Every step you take is recorded. Every step you take is counted.
Then we walk it to the end. Steady spark, higher guard.

final_stand.line: You climbed all this way just to meet the shape of your own ending.
We climbed a long way to end this. Stand down or fall down.

shore_secured.line: The shore is quiet. Log the coordinates and get the wounded home.
Quiet today. We will be back before it gets loud again.
